meta.title: Email Notifications: any workflow event: approval request, bid invitation, PO issued, etc
gaps: Configure or verify the tenant's INT-005 Email Notifications integration and its provider, sender, reply-to, or template overrides.
Inspect the external system's notification and compare recipient email, subject, body, action links, and attachments with Procol.
Verify that no error was recorded for the email integration.

steps.note: Start a multi-stage project so an RFQ invitation can be triggered.
Create the RFQ workflow that will generate a bid invitation.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add a required line item for the RFQ.
Commit a bidding schedule so the event can be published.
Add a recipient to the bid invitation audience.
Publish the RFQ to cause the bid-invitation notification trigger.
Assert that the triggering RFQ was successfully published.
